title: EPIPE handling removed
detail: When sys.stdout or sys.stderr is closed, an OSError with errno.EPIPE is raised. The original code pacified the streams and exited with code 1. The new code only raises if the error is not EPIPE, silently swallowing the error and allowing the command to continue, which can lead to confusing failures or silent data loss.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: DeferredLock exposes a method `locked()` to check lock status, not an attribute. Accessing `self._export_lock.locked` will raise an AttributeError or always evaluate to the method object, causing the lock acquisition logic to misbehave.
